articles.summary_en: Every day, millions of cubic meters of clean water come from factories with tests that meet absolute standards. However, after tens of kilometers of traveling through a network of underground pipes, storing in underground tanks and apartment sinks and then flowing out to each household's faucet, will that drop of water still retain its original quality?
